Questions

What is the median annual wage for HVAC technicians in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $60,820.

What is the hourly median for HVAC technicians in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $29.24.

How many HVAC technicians work in Austin?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 3,140 wage-and-salary Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for HVAC technicians in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.92. Values above 1.00 mean Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers are more concentrated in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for HVAC technicians in Austin?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers in Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos, TX is $63,930.

How does Austin's HVAC technicians median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Austin's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($60,820) is $17,140 lower than Chicago ($77,960) and $19,280 lower than Seattle ($80,100). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
